blocks.title: Enable Installation address for {organization}
blocks.purpose: Shows the public address of this installation to its own organization in app.ever.co, and on the public profile if the owner turns that section on.

leaves_installation.purpose: Link to this installation from the organization's account pages

platform_keeps.retention: Kept while the integration is enabled. Deleted when it is turned off or the installation disconnects.

blocks.where_to_change: Integrations & data in this product, or Instances in app.ever.co; turning it off stops the data at once.
blocks.authorisation: I am authorised to enable this for {organization}
